result.justification: The research objective is clear, addressing the occurrence of various infection scenarios in cancer patients, and the methodology is detailed, describing specific procedures and tools used for analysis.

objective_evidence.quote: we describe multiple longitudinal analyses of 26 different cases of extended SARS-CoV-2 infection in cancer patients.

method_evidence.quote: SARS-CoV-2 tests were performed in naso/oropharyngeal swabs using real-time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) following the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) protocol.
